title: Loops Basics
objectives: Understand loop fundamentals and iteration concepts
Master while loops with proper initialization, condition, and update
Use for loops with range() for counted repetition
Prevent infinite loops and off-by-one errors
Choose the right loop type for different scenarios
description: Master while and for loops to automate repetitive tasks. Learn iteration fundamentals, range(), and avoid common pitfalls like infinite loops. Guided by Emily and Cole through practical countdown timers and hands-on challenges.

exercises.description: Type a while loop with proper condition.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: For Loop
exercises.description: Type a for loop using range().

exercises.description: Initialize and update a loop counter.

exercises.description: The counter never decrements, causing an infinite loop! Add the decrement.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Self-Destruct Countdown
exercises.description: Bomb timer counting down from 10. Type the while loop with decrement.
exercises.targetCode:
timer = 10
while timer > 0:
    print(timer)
    timer -= 1
print('DETONATION!')

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Surveillance Loop Protocol
exercises.description: Professional continuous monitoring system with initialization, condition, and update pattern.
exercises.targetCode:
# Continuous surveillance system
scan_count = 0
max_scans = 5
while scan_count < max_scans:
    print(f'Scan {scan_count + 1} complete')
    scan_count += 1
print('Surveillance cycle finished')

exercises.description: CRITICAL: Drone stuck in infinite patrol! Counter never increments. Add increment or battery dies!

exercises.description: Collect supplies. Start with 0, add 10 per trip. Loop while supplies < 50. Print total at end.

exercises.title: Breach Detection: Security Scan
exercises.description: Print 'SCANNING' 5 times using while loop. Use counter variable starting at 0.

exercises.title: Infiltration: Stealth Approach
exercises.description: Move from position 0 to position 100 in steps of 25. Print each position using while loop.

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Password Cracker
exercises.description: CLASSIFIED: Brute force 4-digit code starting at 1000. Increment by 1 each attempt. Target code is 1005. Print each attempt. Stop when found. Use while loop!
exercises.starterCode:
# Brute force password cracker
attempt = 1000
target = 1005
exercises.solution:
attempt = 1000
target = 1005
while attempt <= target:
    print(attempt)
    attempt += 1
